goal: Test volatility-managed momentum and simple market-regime timing on Ken French daily FF3 + MOM factors; distinguish factor-return research from directly tradable returns.

data_policy.development_window: 1930-01-01..2009-12-31 (task-specified long history; earliest aligned full-signal start 1930-01-02)
data_policy.embargo: 2025-01-01..2026-07-31 inaccessible in wave one; run.py fails closed at --end > 2024-12-31 unless QUANT_HOLDOUT_UNLOCK=1 (never set by this agent)
data_policy.terminology_note: Per explorations/protocol-amendment.json the embargoed stretch is historical_confirmation, not an epistemically blind holdout; untouched evidence begins with the prospective forward shadow from 2026-08-29.
data_policy.data_source: Two pre-collected Ken French daily zips under quant-trading/data/raw/factors (checksums re-verified before parsing). No new data collected.
data_policy.original_task_window_note: The task restated the campaign default as development ending 2009 and validation 2010-2024; this supersedes the shorter 2020-2024 windows in contract.json for this family (planned from the start, recorded pre-results).

units_and_rf.raw_units: All Ken French daily series arrive in percent per day; converted to decimals by /100 before any arithmetic.
units_and_rf.rf_handling: RF is the simple daily rate compounding to the 1-month T-bill (Ibbotson through 2024-05, ICE BofA 1-Month T-Bill Index from 2024-06). Portfolio NAV = RF (collateral yield) + w * MOM (spread) - costs, w in [0,1], so no leverage.
units_and_rf.unit_check: RF-by-decade table in run.py dev output matches economic history: ~0 during 1940s-2007 zero-rate episodes, 10-13% annualized in 1981-1985, near-zero in 2010s baselines; plus 1926-1929 warm-up confirms percent-scale parse (a /10 or /1000 misparse would be glaring).

trial_accounting.budget: Task cap 8 variants <= contract cap 12; total run = 8; none suppressed.
trial_accounting.predeclaration: All 8 variant specs were fixed in run.py VARIANTS before the first dev-window evaluation; no holdout-era data was ever loaded (parser hard-stops at 2024-12-31 in wave one).
trial_accounting.budget_slack_note: 3 remaining headline slots; the 1x/2x cost stress and subperiod cuts of T07 are diagnostics of the frozen pick, not new selection trials.
trial_accounting.selection_rule_predeclared: Pick the single frozen variant with the highest 2009-window net Sharpe, subject to (a) net maxDD < benchmark maxDD, (b) annualized turnover <= 2x one-way (sane tradability tie-break), by a 5bps-per-unit-turnover fixed execution assumption; ties broken toward full funding use.

selection.chosen_variant: T07 = vol-managed, scale-down-only 126d trailing momentum vol vs 6% annualized target, gated OFF in high market-vol states
selection.selection_note: Dev net Sharpe ranking: T07 1.6548 > T03 1.5659 > T06 1.4161 > T02 1.2836 > T05 1.1215 > T04 1.0276 > T08 0.8629 > T01 0.7948 (T01 also IS the benchmark). All 8 pass the dev tie-break constraints; T07 leads.

validation_metrics_frozen_T07.costs: 5bps one-way per unit turnover (contract daily-ETF default); 2x = 10bps stress

selection_adjustment_limitations.sharpe_haircut_for_selection: Best-pick Sharpe across 8 correlated variants is upward biased. White (2000) Reality Check is infeasible here (needs bootstrap of the full 2009-window path, deferred); as a rough control, the ex-post second-best (T03, 1.5659) and median (T04, 1.0276) dev Sharpes bracket a plausible deflated 1.2-1.4 for T07's dev estimate; the frozen pick was NOT upgraded to match validation (single-shot confirmation design).
selection_adjustment_limitations.deflated_sharpe_inputs: n_dev=21090 daily obs, 8 trials, heavy cross-variant correlation (ordered by ranking closeness); DSRS not computed because it needs a variant return-pool bootstrap the contract forbids wasting dev data on. Flagging as an open limitation and proposed upgrade for historical-confirmation stats.
selection_adjustment_limitations.fdr_note: Protocol mandates Holm-Bonferroni FWER (alpha=0.05) and BH-FDR (q=0.10) across all frozen historical-confirmation candidates; factor-timing contributes exactly 1 candidate (T07) to that correction family, decided mechanically from validation metrics.

lesson_notes: Dev-window winner (T07, vol+vol regime) also won validation, but with substantially degraded Sharpe (1.65 dev -> 0.99 val), consistent with momentum's long-run decay plus volatility-managed shrinking the live vol
Scale-down-only exposure cut tail risk massively without losing much excess CAGR: T07 validation maxDD -7.1% vs benchmark -39.9%; benchmark MOM maxDD -70.7% over 1930-2009 dev.
2018-2024 momentum revival: raw momentum Sharpe 0.27 (ann vol 15.4%) vs T07 1.41 (ann vol 4.5%), and the vol-target binding harder post-2015 (mean w 0.35) is what carried it.
Market-trend gates (T04/T08, 6 flips/yr) have the highest turnover and weakest risk-adjusted dev results - simple 126d up/down market timing adds cost and whipsaw more edge.
